dispel.name: Arcane Dispel
dispel.desc: Purge void, burn pits, plague, and other faction blights. Requires a living Mage in cast range.

scout.name: Scout Report
scout.desc: At night only. Tomorrow's host by type goes into the night preview at once, and the head count for each third of the top edge is pinned on the field.

infiltrate.name: Ambush on the Road
infiltrate.desc: An ambush waits where the host comes in, marked on the field. The first 30% of the next wave arrive at 60% health, each tagged AMBUSHED.

assassin.name: Mark the Warlord
assassin.desc: The boss of the next wave, or its strongest elite, is outlined in blood and takes 25% more damage from everything.
